name: Yrsa
source:
A woodcutter from a small village. Focused on defending her fellow villagers from monsters, she doesn't think of herself much.

So why is the elemental she's bonded with so interested in trying to understand her?

[from [url=https://shibalist.itch.io/yrsa-major]itch.io[/url]]
